name: Kruphix
description: Klothys's twin god who helped seal the titans in the Underworld.

timeline.summary: During the Silence of the Gods enacted by Kruphix, Ephara withdraws her direct presence from the world.
timeline.quote: Ephara — like her fellow deities — withdrew her direct presence from the world.

citation.text: "Ephara", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kruphix imposes the Silence of the Gods as the pantheon goes to war.
timeline.quote: Kruphix saw fit to prevent the gods from interacting with the mortals

citation.text: "Heliod", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Xenagos attacks the poleis with otherworldly monsters, blinding the gods, and Kruphix enacts the Silence of the Gods.
timeline.quote: Kruphix then enacted the Silence of the Gods

citation.text: "Theros (plane)", section "The rise and fall of Xenagos". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kruphix enacted the Silence of the Gods, keeping the gods in Nyx.
timeline.quote: Kruphix then enacted the Silence of the Gods

citation.text: "Xenagos", section "Return to Theros". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The tritons explain the Silence, saying the gods retreated into Nyx after Kruphix spoke and blaming the Sun's Champion for slaying Nylea's hydra.
timeline.quote: The Sun's Champion slew Nylea's pet hydra.

citation.text: "Kiora's Followers" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Feb 2014.

timeline.summary: Elspeth and Ajani travel to the Temple of Mystery to commune with Kruphix, assailed by Nyxborn creatures.
timeline.quote: the companions are repeatedly assailed by Nyxborn creatures

citation.work: Planeswalker's Guide to Journey into Nyx
citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Journey into Nyx". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Apr 2014. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Xenagos interrupts and mocks the god-story, breaching storytelling etiquette.
timeline.quote: "And blah, blah, blah, Kruphix slapped their hands and told them to never do it again or they'd be sealed into Nyx like bad children," Xenagos quipped.

citation.work: Theros eBook Godsend , Part 1: Sample Chapter
citation.text: "Theros eBook Godsend , Part 1: Sample Chapter". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Apr 2014. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Xenagos interrogates the oracle Kydele about the hydra, how to reach Nyx, and the edge of the world; she replies in riddles.
timeline.quote: "Is the hydra truly wandering among mortals?" Xenagos asked.

citation.work: Theros eBook Godsend , Part 1: Sample Chapter
citation.text: "Theros eBook Godsend , Part 1: Sample Chapter". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Apr 2014. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Diantha brings the Oracle of Kruphix her meal in Meletis and the oracle says Kruphix once spirited her away to his true temple.
timeline.quote: When I was in danger, Kruphix spirited me away to his temple.

citation.text: "Kruphix's Insight" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Jun 2014.

timeline.summary: Kydele feels dead inside and finds that Kruphix, who had spoken to her constantly, has fallen silent since Heliod's betrayal.
timeline.quote: But since Heliod's act of betrayal, the voice of her god had fallen silent.

citation.text: "Kruphix's Insight" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Jun 2014.

timeline.summary: Kruphix speaks to Kydele, who asks whether what happened was good and why it feels wrong.
timeline.quote: does it all feel so wrong?

citation.text: "Kruphix's Insight" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Jun 2014.

timeline.summary: Kruphix tells Kydele that the gods are beliefs that took form in Nyx, that Heliod was not always the sun god and that gods depend on mortals believing they are unchanging.
timeline.quote: The gods are beliefs that took form within the fabric of Nyx.

citation.text: "Kruphix's Insight" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Jun 2014.

timeline.summary: Kruphix warns her that knowledge is cruel; Kydele insists she wants to know, and they walk to the edge of the world.
timeline.quote: they came to the edge of the world itself

citation.text: "Kruphix's Insight" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Jun 2014.

timeline.summary: Kruphix reveals that Theros is one of many worlds and that world-walkers like Elspeth, Ajani, Kiora and Xenagos have walked between them.
timeline.quote: So was the triton—the merfolk—Kiora, who called herself Callaphe and earned the ire of Thassa.

citation.text: "Kruphix's Insight" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Jun 2014.

timeline.summary: Kruphix explains that Xenagos traveled to godless worlds and tried to show everyone the gods were a lie, but people saw only chaos and he threatened nothing.
timeline.quote: decided everyone on Theros should know the gods were a lie.

citation.text: "Kruphix's Insight" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Jun 2014.

timeline.summary: Kruphix reveals his fear: threats from the Eldrazi, an ancient dragon planeswalker and Phyrexia could destroy Theros while even the gods are powerless.
timeline.quote: even the gods may be powerless to stop them.

citation.text: "Kruphix's Insight" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Jun 2014.

timeline.summary: Kruphix hides dire prophecies about humankind.
timeline.quote: Kruphix hid the most dire prophecies about humankind where humans would never find them and tritons wouldn't care to read them.

citation.text: Sigiled Starfish (Magic Origins, 2015), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Kruphix reveals to Kydele the nature of the gods and Theros's place in the Multiverse.
timeline.quote: Kruphix himself revealed to Kydele the true nature of the gods and Theros's place in the Multiverse, a sight she can never unsee.

citation.work: It's Time to Talk Commander (2016 Edition)!
citation.text: "It's Time to Talk Commander (2016 Edition)!" by Magic Creative Team. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Kruphix glimpses the end: Heliod's spear cast down and broken.
timeline.quote: Far-seeing Kruphix glimpsed the end: Heliod's spear cast down and broken.

citation.text: Return to Nature (Theros Beyond Death, 2020), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Before Xenagos's rise, Kruphix declared the Silence of the Gods to restore balance after chaos in Nyx.
timeline.quote: Kruphix declared the Silence of the Gods

citation.text: "Kruphix", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kruphix and his oracle observed Xenagos's defeat by Elspeth and Ajani and Heliod's later betrayal of Elspeth.
timeline.quote: He and his oracle observed the defeat of Xenagos by Elspeth and Ajani

citation.text: "Kruphix", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kruphix revealed that the gods arose from mortal belief, and even he does not predate it.
timeline.quote: Kruphix revealed that the gods of Theros arose from mortal belief, shaping the fabric of Nyx.

citation.text: "Kruphix", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: New Phyrexia invaded the multiverse, including Theros, confirming Kruphix's fears; the invasion was repelled.
timeline.quote: His fears proved justified when New Phyrexia invaded the multiverse

citation.text: "Kruphix", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Klothys and Kruphix war against the titans and seal them in the Underworld with Klothys watching.
timeline.quote: Victorious, the twin gods sealed the Titans in the Underworld with Klothys to keep watch.

citation.text: "Underworld", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kruphix forms the Nyxborn Nykthos as the first divine artisan; his greatest work is the Shrine to Nyx.
timeline.quote: the Nyxborn known as Nykthos was formed by Kruphix , the god of horizons, as the first divine artisan

citation.text: "Nykthos", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kruphix exerts a binding influence on the borders of the Tovian Fields, preventing the eternal war led by Mogis and Iroas from spreading across Nyx.
timeline.quote: Kruphix claims the borders of the Tovian Fields as his domain

citation.text: "Nyx", section "Locations within Nyx". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kruphix decrees the Silence of the Gods, withdrawing the pantheon into Nyx; Xenagos ascends to godhood as God of Revels.
timeline.quote: He decreed the Silence of the Gods

citation.text: "Silence of the Gods", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

relations.note: Xenagos hates Kruphix's oracles and fears Kruphix deciphering his plans
relations.quote: He should kill her now before Kruphix deciphered his plans.

citation.work: Theros eBook Godsend , Part 1: Sample Chapter
citation.text: "Theros eBook Godsend , Part 1: Sample Chapter". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Apr 2014. Archived by the Internet Archive.

relations.quote: when she awakened as his oracle

citation.text: "Kruphix's Insight" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Jun 2014.

relations.note: Diantha is a priest of Kruphix's temple in Meletis.
relations.quote: I am a priest, and as a priest I have faith—faith in Kruphix's wisdom

citation.text: "Kruphix's Insight" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Jun 2014.

relations.quote: Kydele serves as the primary oracle to Kruphix

citation.work: It's Time to Talk Commander (2016 Edition)!
citation.text: "It's Time to Talk Commander (2016 Edition)!" by Magic Creative Team. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Oct 2016.

relations.quote: She shares a deep mutual respect with Kruphix

citation.text: "Klothys", section "Divine relationships". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

citation.text: "Kruphix", section "Influence and Goals". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

citation.text: "Kruphix", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

relations.note: The two eldest gods; her return troubles him.
relations.quote: Kruphix’s only true concern is Klothys, the other eldest god

citation.text: "Kruphix", section "Influence and Goals". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

relations.quote: though he blames Erebos for Klothys 's unexpected emergence from the Underworld

citation.text: "Kruphix", section "Influence and Goals". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

relations.note: Formed him as first divine artisan.

citation.text: "Nykthos", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
